_note: Edit the numbers here and run make_charts.py. null = pending (drawn as a labelled placeholder, never a guessed value).

throughput._source: Decode tokens/s summed over all streams, four RX 9070 XT, reproducible mode. 1-8 streams: the chat configuration; 8-512: the batch configuration (decode-only rate = decode tokens / decode step time). 512: best of the measured runs, 44,998 decode tokens (first tokens excluded) / 167.46 s.

jobs._source: Client wall time for the whole batch (all requests sent at once, so it equals the server step time within 0.3 s). Earlier configuration: the same engine before most of the batch work. Batched, reproducible mode: BIRD 256 with the public BIRD-train profile; the private SQL set with a profile recorded partly from private prompts.

energy._source: GPU boards + CPU package only (no RAM, board, fans, PSU loss; no wall meter). Mean sampled power x server step time (timestamps, not sample counts). BIRD 256 reproducible mode, BIRD 500 default mode, 256/512 private SQL reproducible mode. kWh per 1,000 requests = J/request / 3600.
